4871-5189-7824.notablePrerequisites: Ghave has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or there is a +1/+1 counter on another creature you control.
4871-5189-7824.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

372-2781-7495.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-2781-7495.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast All Aboard by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

3819-5671-7809.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Cultivator Colossus enters, it triggers, attempting to put Kjeldoran Outpost from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Kjeldoran Outpost into your graveyard.
Afterwards, continue resolving the Cultivator Colossus trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Kjeldoran Outpost from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability. Then, repeat the process, attempting to put Kjeldoran Outpost from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Kjeldoran Outpost into your graveyard.
Repeat step 3.
3819-5671-7809.notes: You can return other lands with their dredge abilities instead, as you're able to do so.

789-1580-2292-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more oil counters on it

2450-3120-4050-7639.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U} due to Mindsplice Apparatus.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1116-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

539-5686-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

6132-6798-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

1781-1978-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
1781-1978-5168.description:
Cause Bloom Tender to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat from step 2.

849-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
849-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

413-3951-4192-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Ashes of the Fallen on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
413-3951-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
When the creature token(s) enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1263-4871-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {R}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

695-813-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Settle Beyond Reality.
695-813-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

880-2653-3534.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control an additional creature.
880-2653-3534.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Field of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1247-5833-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control four or more creatures.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5833-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Leafkin Druid's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

64-1987-3617-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
64-1987-3617-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

2034-2124-4616.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
2034-2124-4616.description:
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
When the Knight dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Repeat.

427-1283-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kydele.
You have drawn at least two cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-1283-4222.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

1242-1656-2987.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1242-1656-2987.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1479-2638-3861.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2638-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Tracker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-1778-5222-5256.description:
Cast Memnite.
Equip Sword of the Realms to Memnite for {0}.
Sacrifice Memnite to Altar of Dementia to mill target player three.
Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Memnite to your hand.
Repeat.

1020-2478-4986-5256.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of a player's library and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Myr Retriever.
Myr Retriever triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Myr Retriever's power.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1738-2302-4215-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Serra Avatar.
Serra Avatar and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Serra Avatar trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Serra Avatar, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Serra Avatar's power.
Repeat.
